description: This PHP source file defines the CandidateAttachmentAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing candidate attachment data in a recruitment module of an HR management system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting candidate attachments, utilizing various validators, models, and services.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for managing candidate attachments within the recruitment module, including create, retrieve, update, and delete operations, with validation and service integration.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Placeholder method for retrieving all candidate attachments; not implemented in this API.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method; not implemented.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new candidate attachment using request parameters, validates input, and saves via service, returning the created attachment model.

methods.name: setCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Associates candidate ID with attachment object and sets file details from Base64 input.

methods.name: setBase64Attachment
methods.description: Extracts Base64 file data from request and assigns file name, type, size, and content to the attachment object.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create endpoint, ensuring candidate ID exists and attachment is valid.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation; not implemented.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single candidate attachment based on candidate ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a single attachment, requiring candidate ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing candidate attachment, optionally replacing or deleting the current attachment based on request input.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update endpoint, including positive ID check and string length validation.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachment
methods.description: Converts a CandidateAttachment entity into a RecruitmentAttachment DTO for response.
